verdict.rationale: Performance and item caps at large task volumes are a fair question for an issue tracker like Jira, but the evidence pack has no documentation of performance at tens of thousands of issues or of any item, issue, or project limits. Community remarks about the UI being quick or slow are general anecdotes, not about behavior at scale, so they establish neither delivery nor a dispute.

support.subject: As an engineer, I know how the product performs and whether item caps apply in workspaces with tens of thousands of tasks
